change.source: acceptance finding 1 (check 7 waits for the system clock to pass an expires 2 s ahead): the bridge gets --clock-file, read as inbox serve --clock-file is (debug build only, hidden from the help, through FileClock, failing closed), a file of its own because the service's file must stay within 60 s of the system clock; the check moves the bridge's file to expires + 59 min (the entry stays after 2 polls) and to expires + 1 h 1 s (gone after 2 more polls) and waits only on the stand-in's count of polls; check 8 names the file; the flag and clock_file.rs are in Scope
